name: Vincenzo Sguera
description: Vincenzo Sguera | Artist & Designer Born in 1950 and a graduate of the Florence School of Architecture , Vincenzo Sguera is a versatile Italian architect, artist, and creative director. Career Highlights: Creative Leadership: In 1982, he founded the NEXT studio. As a Creative Director, he developed licensed product lines for global icons like Hello Kitty , Snoopy , and The Simpsons , as well as fashion giants like Diesel and Benetton . Publishing: Since 2008, he has focused on Arkivia Books , an editorial project providing high-quality visual libraries and trend books for the international design and fashion industries. Expertise: He is a renowned specialist in surface design , textures, and patterns, having authored dozens of professional volumes used by designers worldwide to inspire contemporary graphics and textiles.
